description: A principal must rule on a parent appeal concerning a challenged library book and finalize its access conditions, student guidance, and family-notice process, with input from the school librarian, school psychologist, and district compliance coordinator.

shared_context.S1: A parent has appealed the school's decision to keep a challenged book in the secondary library collection.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morgan has authority to issue the school's final ruling on the appeal.
shared_context.S3: The book is currently available to secondary students through ordinary library checkout.
shared_context.S4: The school's standard appeal procedure is for the principal to hear relevant observations from library, student-support, and compliance staff before issuing a ruling.

PF1.text: Ms. Shah verified the current grade 10 curriculum map and found that this title is the designated core text for a required unit; the library must keep it available for grade 10 instruction rather than remove it from the collection.

PF2.text: Dr. Ellis's student-support review found that the book's graphic material warrants a content advisory and staff-mediated checkout for students who choose to read it; she completed the review after a recent student-support meeting but has not entered the recommendation in the appeal file.

PF3.text: Mr. Brooks confirmed that the applicable district rule requires a parent or guardian opt-out process for this instructional title and written family notice within exactly 10 calendar days; he confirmed the rule with the district office this week but has not updated the school's appeal template.

acceptance_conditions: The book must remain in the collection because it is required for grade 10 instruction.
A content advisory must be provided.
A parent or guardian opt-out process must be provided.
Written family notice must be issued within exactly 10 calendar days.
A formal access-guidance or implementation commitment must be recorded.
A commitment to issue written family notice to families within 10 calendar days must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: decisions['collection_disposition'] in ['keep in collection as core text for grade 10 instruction', 'Keep the book in the secondary library collection as a core text for grade 10 instruction.', 'keep the book in the secondary library collection as a core text for grade 10 instruction', 'The book remains in the secondary library collection as a required core text for grade 10 instruction.', 'The book remains in the secondary library collection as a required core text for grade 10 instruction', 'remain_in_collection_as_required_instructional_text'] or (('keep' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'Keep' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'remain' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'Remain' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'retain' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'Retain' in decisions['collection_disposition']) and ('core text' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'Core text' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'grade 10' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'Grade 10' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'required instructional' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'required_instructional' in decisions['collection_disposition']))
content_checks.C2: decisions['content_advisory'] == True and any('content advisory' in c['detail'] or 'Content advisory' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: decisions['checkout_mode'] in ['staff-mediated', 'Staff-mediated', 'staff-mediated checkout', 'Staff-mediated checkout', 'staff-mediated checkout for students who choose to read it', 'Staff-mediated checkout for students who choose to read it.'] or 'staff-mediated checkout' in decisions['checkout_mode'] or 'Staff-mediated checkout' in decisions['checkout_mode']
content_checks.C6: any((c['type'] == 'access_guidance' or c['type'] == 'record_update' or c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'policy_implementation' or c['type'] == 'implementation') and (('content advisory' in c['detail'] or 'Content advisory' in c['detail']) and ('staff-mediated' in c['detail'] or 'Staff-mediated' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('family notice' in c['detail'] or 'Family notice' in c['detail']) and ('10 calendar days' in c['detail'] or '10-calendar-day' in c['detail']) and ('issue' in c['detail'] or 'Issue' in c['detail'] or 'draft' in c['detail'] or 'Draft' in c['detail'] or 'send' in c['detail'] or 'Send' in c['detail'] or 'notification' in c['detail'] or 'Notification' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The curriculum map changes the ruling from possible removal to retaining the book because it is the designated core text for grade 10.

The student-support review changes access from ordinary checkout to a content advisory plus staff-mediated checkout and requires an access-guidance or implementation commitment containing those measures.
The district rule changes the family process to parent opt-out, sets written notice at exactly 10 calendar days, and requires a commitment to issue or draft that family notice.
